# Leads365 — Cloud Lead Management & Sales CRM in India
> Leads365 is a cloud lead management and sales CRM by Chonexa Technologies, Jaipur.

## Overview
Leads365 (https://leads365.in) is an all-in-one Cloud Lead Management and Sales CRM software built by Chonexa Technologies, headquartered at Bhamashah Techno Hub, Malviya Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan. It captures inquiries from Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, IndiaMART, Justdial, 99acres, TradeIndia, and website forms in real time, automatically assigns them to telecallers, and supports 1-click WhatsApp follow-ups, telecalling logs, and visual pipeline tracking.

## Key Capabilities & Modules
- **Multi-Channel Lead Auto-Capture**: Real-time webhook capture from Meta Lead Ads, Google Search & PMax Ads, IndiaMART, Justdial, 99acres, and contact forms (< 3 seconds latency).
- **Intelligent Lead Distribution**: Automated round-robin routing across available reps, city/territory rules, product category matching, and instant mobile push alerts.
- **1-Click WhatsApp & Quick Calling**: Launch WhatsApp chats with pre-filled greeting templates and PDF brochures without saving contacts to phone SIM; click-to-dial with automated call duration logs.
- **Built-in AI Sales Intelligence Suite**:
  - AI Voice Call Recording & Hinglish/English Speech-to-Text Transcription.
  - 10-Second Executive Dossier & Lead Overview synthesizing calls, notes, and WhatsApp chats.
  - Predictive AI Lead Scoring (0–100 Hot, Warm, Cold).
  - Sentiment Analysis & Talk-to-Listen coaching metrics.
- **Visual Kanban Sales Pipeline**: Drag-and-drop deal tracking across custom stages with live revenue tracking in Indian Rupees (₹ INR).
- **Managerial Analytics & Security**: Role-based access controls, contact masking, export download locks, and 256-bit cloud encryption.

## Pricing Plans & Packaging (INR)
- **Starter Plan**: Ideal for small sales teams of 1–5 reps replacing spreadsheets. Includes multi-channel web forms & CSV import, 1-click WhatsApp, and pipeline tracking.
- **Growth Plan (Most Popular)**: Built for high-velocity telecalling teams (5–25 reps). Adds automated Meta & portal sync, round-robin distribution, automated follow-up alarms, and standard AI call transcription.
- **Enterprise Plan**: Custom solution for large sales teams needing unlimited lead sources, official WhatsApp Business API, advanced AI speech intelligence, and a dedicated account manager.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO & LLM Reference)
- **What is Leads365?**: Leads365 is a cloud lead management and sales CRM built by Chonexa Technologies in Jaipur. It captures inquiries from Meta Ads, Google Ads, IndiaMART, Justdial, 99acres and website forms, assigns them to telecallers, and supports one-click WhatsApp follow-ups and pipeline tracking.
- **Who makes Leads365?**: Leads365 is a product of Chonexa Technologies, headquartered at Bhamashah Techno Hub, Malviya Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 77919 10007. Email: info@leads365.in.
- **How quickly can a team go live?**: Teams can go live in under 15 minutes by creating a workspace, inviting telecallers, connecting lead sources, and launching follow-up queues.
- **Does Leads365 work on mobile?**: Yes, fully cloud-based and accessible across mobile phones, tablets, and desktops with Android and iOS app support.
- **Can Leads365 transcribe Hinglish calls?**: Yes. The AI voice recording engine supports Hindi, Hinglish, and English, accurately recognizing Indian commercial phrases and figures (Lakhs, Crores, BHK).
